title: AAA Pipeline with Non-Repudiation Sidebar
description: Interactive Mermaid flow diagram of the Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting pipeline, with a non-repudiation sidebar fed by cryptographic evidence. Hover or tap each stage for a concrete definition.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Distinguish authentication from authorization from accounting.
Explain how each stage of the AAA pipeline governs access to a protected resource.
Describe how non-repudiation depends on cryptographic evidence drawn from authentication and accounting.
educational.prerequisites: Basic familiarity with the idea of user accounts and logins.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to map a real login event onto the five stages.
misconceptionsAddressed: Treating authentication and authorization as the same step.
Assuming logging is optional rather than the basis for accountability and non-repudiation.
